description: The edits atoll disk add, remove, fail and replace make to the configuration: every other byte kept, comments included. op add appends disk at the end; remove takes out the [[disk]] with that id; state sets its state, or takes the key out for an empty one. result is the whole text after the edit; error, an edit refused, the file left as it is.

cases.note: a disk at the end, after a blank line: id, uuid, mount, fs
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
cases.result:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"

[[disk]]
id = "u2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "/mnt/u2"
fs = "ext4"

cases.note: every key, in this order: id, uuid, mount, fs, role, domain, tags, root, workdir, state
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
cases.result:

uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "/mnt/u2"
fs = "ext4"
role = "cache"
domain = "d4-320"
tags = ["usb", "slow"]
root = "films"
workdir = "atoll-work"
state = "draining"
